subject: VP/CIO briefing — request to anchor + alternate coverage
messages:
From: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@solstice.io>
To: chloe_martin@redwood.com
Cc: Maya Kapoor <m.kapoor@solstice.io>
Date: Thu, 29 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Need to shift VP/CIO briefing — Thursday window

Hi Chloe,

Quick one — our VP (Priya) and CIO (Arman) have a conflict for the Thursday slot we booked. We still want the executive walkthrough next week but need to move the VP/CIO portion to a later window the same day if possible.

Is there any chance you can push the executive 45–60 minute block later in the day (3:00–4:30 PT) and keep the technical deep-dive earlier? If that doesn’t work, we can swap in a different VP-level attendee from our side but would prefer Priya/Arman to be present.

Also, we’ll need a one-pager agenda for the exec portion and a short mutual action plan we can share with procurement. Can you send both?

Thanks — Jordan
Jordan Lee
Director, Product Partnerships
Solstice Industries

From: chloe_martin@redwood.com
To: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@solstice.io>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, priyom_das@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 29 Apr 2027 10:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Need to shift VP/CIO briefing — Thursday window

Jordan — thanks for the heads up. We can absolutely accommodate a swap; I proposed two anchor plans below so you can pick what fits your exec calendar:

Option A (preferred):
- Exec brief (45 min): 15:15–16:00 PT (Redwood VP + CTO overview, business impact, high-level economics)
- Tech deep-dive (60 min): 13:30–14:30 PT (engineers + product)

Option B (if Priya/Arman need slightly later):
- Exec brief (45 min): 16:30–17:15 PT
- Tech deep-dive (60 min): 12:30–13:30 PT

Action items for you: confirm which option and whether Priya/Arman can make the Option A anchor (15:15). If they can’t, say Option B and we’ll line up alternate leadership coverage.

I attached a one-page exec agenda and a short mutual action plan (first drafts) — feel free to share with procurement. Ben and Priyom are cc’d to help with coverage and any escalation on timing or attendee mix.

If you confirm Option A I’ll lock the calendar and add a brief pre-call note for the demo owner.

Best,
Chloe Martin
Senior Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference
chloe_martin@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0172

Attachments: Redwood-demo-agenda-v1.pdf (1 page), Mutual-Action-Plan.xlsx (spreadsheet)

Jordan
